action: Push for a definitive response from RoboRide fleet operations. Howard calls the regional fleet ops contact again — not a re-pitch, a close. He references the vendor proposal from last tick and the $1,800+ in inventory he allocated as a demonstration of seriousness. He asks directly: 'I sent the proposal, I showed you I can move fast. I need to know this week — is there a trial order on the table, or do we need to schedule fifteen minutes with your fleet maintenance supervisor to make that happen?' Howard frames the ask as respecting their time: he is not looking for a maybe, he is looking for a path to yes or a clear no so he can plan his inventory accordingly. If they are not the right contact, he asks who is. The goal of this call is a scheduled meeting with fleet maintenance or a trial order within two weeks.
